name: smwgraphics-snowy-snowland
title: Snowy Snowland
description:
Some tileset I have been working on every so often for about six months. It's a Snowy Snowland, and has trees, snowpiles, ledges and also, slopes.

The trees are actually climbable. You can either indicate that with a message box, or change the act like setting if you don't want that to happen.

Have fun with this tileset!
